implement_simple_reward_measure: implement a Habitat RL SimpleReward measure class that computes composite navigation rewards from success, distance, and angle metrics
configure_reward_components: configure the SimpleReward measure with SUCCESS_REWARD, USE_DTG_REWARD, USE_ATG_REWARD, and SLACK_PENALTY config options
reset_reward_metric: reset the SimpleReward metric and previous distance-to-goal and angle-to-goal state at episode start
update_reward_metric: update the SimpleReward metric by combining success reward, distance-to-goal reward, angle-to-goal reward, angle success reward, and slack penalty
register_reward_measure: register the SimpleReward measure class with the Habitat registry using the simple_reward UUID
